g.title: HR_GDPRAUDITREQUESTRESPONSE
g.text: GDPR Audit Request Response - This is the response to a request for data obsolescence and includes, by category of data, some information related to, for instance, how many records are managed in the database, what is the oldest date time a record was last updated, the oldest document reference date etc.
A request for information under GDPR.
This is a Category of data, as described in the catalogue of Personal Data classification for Privacy and data protection purposes, to which the obsolescence report refers.
The total number of physical records that exist in the database related to the selected inquiry.
The oldest date a record was last modified.
The most recent date a record was last modified.
The oldest reference date for a record.
The most recent reference date for a record.
An optional link URI to a product function or service where data this report refers to is located.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_GDPRREQUEST
g.text: Personal Data Privacy Request - This entity manages requests to exercise rights around personal data privacy. With this entity, you can for example ask to anonymize data for terminated employees or audit data obsolescence.
The Identifier of the Person record.
Is the full name of the person in the Company who authorised the request.
The number assigned to this request.
Is the date the request has been formalized.
The date the item was submitted.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
